verdict.rationale: GitHub docs explicitly claim 'Undetected Browser Support: Bypass sophisticated bot detection systems,' backed by related features like Managed Browser (user-owned browsers avoiding bot detection), stealth modes, and session re-use, giving concrete first-party evidence of the capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation that the undetected mode actually defeats specific real-world anti-bot systems (e.g., Cloudflare, PerimeterX) and detail on how it's configured.
